name: S3
description: Simple Storage Service and object storage
attack_surface: Bucket listings, upload files endpoints, access control policies
common_misconfigurations: S3 bucket read access granted to anonymous users
Over-permissive upload rules allowing arbitrary HTML/script execution
Missing bucket logging or security policy rules
validation_methods: Check directory layout anonymously in browser
Attempt uploads of sample test files using aws-cli tool
evidence_requirements: HTTP response showing listing of XML content from bucket URL
Success code trace from bucket upload test command
false_positive_indicators: Access denied returned on all metadata files
Buckets that only allow public upload to sandbox folders without read execution
reporting_guidance: Focus on read/write exposure of sensitive files. Bucket policy warnings without listing access are low value.
